issues.description: The problem statement explicitly asks students to implement public getters for each attribute (see tasks and tests like getLectureNameTest()). In the provided solution, two getter methods are declared private (getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()), which contradicts the expectation that these getters be publicly accessible. This visibility mismatch will confuse students and cause any tests or example usages that expect public getters to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters for all attributes public to match the problem statement and expected tests. Specifically, change the visibility of getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() from private to public (i.e., public String getLectureName() { ... } and public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents() { ... }). Ensure all getters are public in both template guidance and solution so students and tests have a consistent expectation.
